assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Julius's phases from the V04 court encounter, duel and private accountability (J04) through the V07 qualified apology and Yuri aid (J07), the living and terminal V08 operation (J08O, J08T), the depicted V09 renewed council, shared-sense battle and aftermath (J09) and the V16 peer, ordinary and private scenes (J16), with the model's default being the latest personally observed V16 garden conversation after the disrupted meal and before the park (p-017#B0423-0430). dimensions.note: Section 1's thesis (making care answerable to a publicly intelligible role, with the harm done when dignity measures another person's standing), twenty-four eight-field conditional rules with exceptions, section 4's knowledge firewall and section 10's four rejected rival readings with a mixed model and named revision triggers form a rule-level inferential structure on thirty-two located bundles. Counterweights: a single same-analyst artifact built on five volumes; Julius is seen through Subaru's narration; the model leaves what he still endorses of the court doctrine, his complete duel motives and his private reasons for disclosures partly open.

Section 2's seven-axis table and six phase selectors (J04, J07, J08O, J08T, J09, J16) bind each phase to its event state and forbid carrying later friendship, voice flexibility or received criticism back into V04, while section 4 tables what each phase's Julius can know. The trajectory from class challenge to qualified apology, entrusted perception and private reciprocity is located at four points, but V10-V15 are unobserved, late V09 timing is unmarked and the horizon ends at V16 while the project spine is V17.

Section 7 records eleven located short forms with loci and operational readings: エミリア様, 私 and 君, 美しくない, 拝命しました, the ユーリ alias, 精霊騎士 and 蕾, 貴様 beside スバル in the possession appeal, 我が友 at the trust scene, お言葉ですが opening a jurisdiction refusal, the repeated 心まで鎧を that Subaru authored, and 嗜み. It instructs selecting speaker, recipient, office, audience and pressure before imitation and describing a speech strategy rather than claiming exact wording where the source is silent. No sentence-final inventory, frequency data or extended-speech model exists.

Section 6 gives ten ordinary rows, mostly single V16 observations: hair-adjusting and polished dress, finishing Anastasia's burned food before a tactful request, praising her kimono, the flexibility split, professed musical cultivation, the floor-care correction for inn staff, accepting Ferris's treatment and concern for Joshua, plus V07 teasing. Favorite food, books, genre, training hours, spending and a normal day away from duty are named SOURCE_SILENT.

Section 5 conditions the decision by recipient: Subaru across four phases from insulting claimant to entrusted perceiver and criticizing friend; Anastasia's face-preserving service and tactful correction; Reinhard's humiliation and reported obedience; Joshua's frailty; the spirits as partners he will not discard; Ferris's shared coordination but divergent terminal response; Marcos's accepted discipline and Heinkel's unbinding rank, with matched-recipient contrasts on the same low-stakes problem. Julius-side only; Joshua and Heinkel rest on one scene each and inner access to any recipient is denied.

Interior evidence is self-report in located scenes: accepting blame and naming private resentment in the V04 accountability (E08), the explicit nonretraction inside the apology (E12), asking whether the man he hurt can trust him (E18), the private thanks and accepted sting of the heart-in-armor image (E30) and regret about hearsay (E31). Julius is not focalized, his complete duel motives and doctrine endorsement remain underdetermined, and the model supplies no interior model beyond those scenes.

Rules R01-R04, R09, R10, R13-R15 and R20 cover the class challenge and coercive lesson with its accepted discipline, the surprise counter, the refusal to discard spirits, the refused then enacted lethal act in the terminal branch, the eye-closure entrustment, the wall counterexample, the nonlethal host trap and the polite jurisdiction refusal, each with an adverse case (E05-E08 excess and injury, E16 steel). Post-V16 conflict and any other possession condition are outside the set.

Moral positions are argued in his own words: pointing to Emilia's face against care that hurts its recipient (E04), the apology that explicitly does not retract his doctrine (E12), refusing to abandon his spirits (E15), objecting to the lethal request on obligation and unfinished talk (E16), asking for trust without demanding forgiveness (E18), the jurisdiction refusal (E29) and grading his own hearsay (E31). The model gives no general deliberation procedure, leaves the court doctrine partly endorsed and forbids reading intent as erasure of harm.

The misfiring dragon and injury joke, the transparent Yuri fiction and its V16 recall, prospective celebration teasing while wounded, the flexibility contest and the music exchange are located (E09, E23, E32), and rule R23 treats bounded play as a way through an awkward mood with MEDIUM unfamiliar transfer. Instances are few, mostly V07 and V16, and the only exact quoted form is the alias.

Section 3 fixes five locked Japanese witnesses by SHA-256 and section 14 states twenty-three bounded deliveries across V04, V07, V08, V09 and V16, 1,907 text positions, explicitly not five fresh complete rereads. V05, V06 and V10-V15 are not revisited, the corpus label is a horizon rather than an appearance claim, and the declared V16 horizon excludes the project's later admitted volume and the separate review.

Twenty-six negative controls, four rejected rival readings with the mixed model's revision triggers, the actual excess and five-day suspension of the duel (E06, E08), the explicit nonretraction (E12), the terminal steel at the dying neck (E16), the stone-enabled wall breach that limits the all-cutting rhetoric (E21), the immediate regret about hearsay (E31) and NC02's rule that intent does not erase harm are affirmative, located constraints. All sit inside one artifact with the project's own review.

Phases are bound to E008, E011 and its death, E012, E013 and the pre-E019 default; terminal and living operations are separated; NC08 and NC10 deny successor recall of the terminal killing and its replay; the default is fixed to the last observed garden rather than an invented E019 reaction, and section 4 tables availability per selection. Late V09 timing, the V10-V15 gap and the V17 spine lag bound it.

known_limits.statement: The model declares its horizon as V01-V16 and its default as the last observed V16 garden, states that Julius's location and receipt at E019 are unshown and returns ENDPOINT_NOT_YET_READ or KNOWLEDGE_STATE_UNKNOWN for later questions; the project's admitted spine has since reached V17, so the default is the end of this evidence set, not the continuity's latest state.

The model records its fidelity state as PASS_WITH_BOUND, same analyst, nonblind, documentary, with no independent, held-out, runtime or global grade, and sets do_not_use_as_primary_literary_authority to true as a derived-use artifact subordinate to the frozen readings, the ledgers and the Japanese source.

Load-bearing evidence comes from V04, V07, V08, V09 and V16 only; the model states that V05, V06 and V10-V15 are not revisited and that the range does not establish an exhaustive childhood, family history or diary, so the change between the V09 trust scene and the V16 reciprocity is observed in its result, not its process.

What Julius still endorses of the V04 station and lineage doctrine, his complete duel motives, his full family history and his private reasons for every disclosure remain underdetermined in the model's own terms; the avoided lethal retaliation is an assessed possibility, not an observed alternative, and intent does not erase the injury he inflicted.

Successor Julius does not retain the terminal E011 killing, Subaru received only part of the private V04 accountability, Nect was released before the witch scene and supplies no RBD or thought access, and modern vocabulary is unfamiliar; section 4 governs what each phase's Julius can know.

The separate fidelity review, the frozen readings, the ledgers, the protocol and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated on this subject, and the project's later admitted V17 lies outside this set; none was used, and missing support is not evidence of absence.

dimensions.note: Twenty-one conditional rules (J25-R01-R21) each give the situation, Julius's appraisal, the likely response and value at stake, and the boundary or nearest contrary case. They say what changes the response: the audience and jurisdiction (R01, R06), whether the person in front of him can remember him or Joshua (R09, R14, R15), whether the cost of error falls on someone else (R04, R13, R21) and whether the others concerned are free to choose (R16, R19). The central question the model poses, when he uses a cultivated form to make himself answerable and when he uses its authority to settle a question someone else should answer, is answered by these inputs rather than left open. It predicts his overreach as well as his virtue: the classed public challenge and calculated beating (R01-R02), placing Ia without full consent (R04), the sword at the occupied throat (R13) and the solo risk Ram criticizes. Not A: R02 is partial for motive, R13 is weak for a settled assessment of trust, R14 is moderate for unfamiliar situations, and the account is one derived synthesis whose separate review is not in this evidence set.

The section 2 state table separates V04 E008, the V07-V09 E011, E012 and E013 receipts, V16 pre-E019, the V17-V20 city and name loss, V21-V22 approach and tower states, V23 E025-E027, V24 E028-E029 and V25 E046, and says for each what to withhold. It does not backdate acquired confidence or disclosure: the V16 friend keeps his remembered first meetings, the E011 finishing mercy is not an E012 memory, E026 corpse evidence is not an E027 death, and Joshua's kinship after V20 is propositional knowledge without remembered episodes. Not A: V01-V03 give no continuous Julius interior, and the model records no staged general revision of his V04 class doctrine, so that development is inferred from later conduct.

Section 8 gives a recipient table of speech actions: the formal hand-kiss and public argument at court, handing over his sword and declining a command among knights, the marriage-joke rejoinder and brotherly reproof, the demand and conditional cooperation with Echidna, the address to the six and to Reid, and the ceremonial introduction to the returned human Anastasia. It names 私 and 君, measured and often interrogative speech with Subaru, and the corrected tense in the adoption account. Not B: beyond those two pronouns it gives no profile of sentence endings, honorific levels or lexicon, and it warns that his slow syntax and honorifics do not measure how calm he is, so generated wording is constrained by speech act and recipient rather than by register. Not D: the speech actions are located, recipient-specific and discriminating.

Located ordinary conduct: eating Anastasia's charred Daisukiyaki and proposing a shorter cooking time, correcting Joshua's discourtesy, the full split on Subaru's challenge, allowing that he can play an instrument, pleasure in wind and sky as Yuri, a standard of conduct even for a yawn, explaining a calming touch for ground dragons, being listed among those who can cook, and joking when carried (R07, R12). The model's 'ordinary repertoire with a ceiling' paragraph states the limits: no timetable, musical repertoire, recipe, favorite color or solitary hobby. Not B: these are located episodes with a recipient condition, not a routine model. Not D: R07 makes them usable for bounded host, sibling and peer scenes.

Recipient is a required input, and the model separates the listener from the person spoken about and from the body a speaker occupies. It gives distinct conditioned conduct toward Subaru across his states (V04 opponent, V07 qualified reconciliation, V09 trust question, V16 garden friend, V21 the one who can call him ordinary, V22 concealment wound, E027 amnesiac, E028 open apology, E046 joint fight), Joshua before and after erasure, Ricardo, Reinhard, Ferris and Marcos, Emilia remembered and forgotten, scarf Echidna versus the human Anastasia, the six before and after severance, manifested Reid and Ram's withheld pardon. Not A: Reinhard and Joshua after erasure are never met in a staged reunion, the returned human Anastasia is sampled only in the first hours, and the six's own reasons are unavailable.

Interior access is located across many states with causes: irritation and confidence in his own control at the V04 duel, dread under Roy's familiar address (V19-V20), astonishment then laughter at Subaru's refusal to rank losses (V20), treasuring 'ordinary' from the one friend who remembers him (V21), the narration of his commoner childhood and reasons for service (V21, V25), the wound that Subaru doubted he could bear knowing (V22), dread of an apology he cannot answer (E027), hearing more in a stranger's observation than was meant (E028), and the pain of severing the six (V25). Not A: V01-V03 supply no continuous interior, V04 motive is partial, and the model refuses to assign the six's private reasons or the means by which Anastasia's voice reached him.

Conflict is modeled under changing stakes with his failures kept: the chosen terms of the V04 beating and its sanction, hesitation then finishing mercy in E011 versus releasing Nect and calling Ferris in E012, striking the Cult without restraint while later preserving Roy for the victims, two defeats by manifested Reid with the early return and concealed pain (R12), the threat to the occupied body lowered when the cost to both women is clear (R13), and the E046 bout in which he lands a real wound and concedes (R19). Capacity is tied to resources: sword skill persists when spirit cooperation fails, and Al Cranvel's first successful manifestation is not a guarantee of repetition. Not A: no conflict with Reinhard, Joshua or the returned Anastasia is sampled, and post-E046 capacity is unshown.

The model covers deliberation with its costs: the public classed challenge and the private accountability before the commander, with the injured party absent (R01-R02); apology that the recipient may qualify (R03); protective intervention without full consent, followed by asking for trust before deeper use (R04); reserve about the general he killed, then fuller disclosure under a friend's pressure (R11); acting on uncertainty with Echidna (R13); choosing to sever the six so they can choose (R16); and preferring custody and a surer answer over killing Roy for Joshua's sake (R21), together with the V20 belief that every person contains good. Not A: V25 stages no general retraction of his V04 class doctrine, and R21 explicitly yields no universal doctrine about lethal force.

Located play with conditions: the split contest and willing competition with a private peer (R07), a decent rejoinder to Ricardo's marriage joke, laughing after Subaru's refusal in V20, tolerating teasing about his tension on the road, joking about the ride while carried after defeat (R12), and the single short laugh at Echidna's relayed message in the middle of the V25 fight. Not B: there is no account of when Julius initiates humor or of its wording. Not D: R07 and R12 condition play on recipient and stakes, and the V25 laugh is marked as extraordinary to anyone who knew him.

The model covers V01-V25 with dense volume, member and block locators per section, rule and probe, names which early volumes give no continuous interior, and corrects two inherited claims against the originals (RZ-V25-C734 parentage, C739 Al Cranvel chronology) while keeping the C736 contract-wording tension open. Not A: the evaluator could not recheck any locator, the separate fidelity review is not in this evidence set, and V01-V03 are thin.

The model gives affirmative limits: no remembered request to kill Subaru in the renewed operation; Roy's vivid garden story does not restore Joshua; Shaknar does not recognize him; the returned Anastasia does not remember hiring him; Ram neither grants nor refuses pardon; the scar is below the left eye; the Dragon Sword plays no role in E046; Al Cranvel had never succeeded before (C739); his father had left a noble house and his mother was a commoner (C734); Reid's use of his name does not restore public recognition; and the V22 cut-contract wording and the V25 enduring-contract narration are kept as incompatible sources. Not A: some exclusions, such as no favorite tune or recipe, are stated absences rather than affirmative contradictions.

Claims are bound to volume, member and block range and to named event states, with receipt dated by who heard what and when ('receipt has a date'): Anastasia's encouragement is heard at the crisis, her reason later; the E028 assurance about Emilia is not an E046 memory; earlier Subaru selves supply no personal memories. Not A: V01-V03 have no located Julius states, and the C736 contract wording leaves one transition's exact state open.

known_limits.statement: Julius's survival, location, reaction and knowledge after the later shadow are unshown; the default stops at the Roy custody deliberation, and Anastasia's later report of his departure is hers (section 2 default, P09).

After the name loss Julius knows Joshua as his brother only from Subaru's testimony and the faces he can compare; Roy's garden story does not restore a memory, and no restoration, interrogation result or brothers' meeting is performed (R09, P03, section 6).

Other people's prior recognition of Julius stays erased through V25: his dragon, the returned human Anastasia and strangers do not remember him, Emilia's return gives no universal reversal rule, and Reid's use of his name certifies nothing about society's recognition (sections 4 and 6, R19).
V25 supplies no scene of a general public retraction of the V04 classed challenge; his later commoner childhood and conduct give it bite but do not stage a revision (section 4).

R02 is strong for the performed V04 beating and partial for motive: deterrence, real irritation, confidence in his own control and institutional damage are all material, and the injured party was absent from the accountability scene.

The V22 cut-contract wording and the V25 narration of an enduring contract have incompatible literal implications; the model keeps both and the practical sequence and invents no intermediate repair (section 5, C736 open).
The six spirits' private reasons for returning after the severance are not reported, and their retrieving former memories would need its own evidence (sections 1 and 6).

The separate V01-V25 fidelity review, the V25 claim register, the Arc 6 checkpoint, the owner ledgers, the source lock and the primary Japanese sources are not curated on this subject, and the row's V01-V16 model was not used, so no locator was rechecked and no independent probe result is in this evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
The model is one synthesis derived from the project's own frozen readings and ledgers; its paired probes P01-P09 are noncanonical documentary applications, not held-out tests.
